mn143:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn143:2.1: tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
mn143:2.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
mn143:2.3: ehi tvaṃ bho purisa yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi evañca vadehi
mn143:2.4: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
mn143:2.6: yena cāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandāhi evañca vadehi
mn143:2.7: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
mn143:2.8: so āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandatīti
mn143:2.10: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn143:2.11: evambhanteti kho so puriso anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn143:2.12: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
mn143:2.14: yena cāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
mn143:2.15: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
mn143:2.16: so āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandati
mn143:2.18: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā sārīputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn143:3.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho āyasmā sāriputto anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
mn143:3.2: kacci te gahapati khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
mn143:4.1: na me bhante sāriputta khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
mn143:4.2: seyyathāpi bhante sāriputta balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhānaṃ abhimattheyya evameva kho me bhante sāriputta adhimattā vātā muddhānaṃ ohananti
mn143:4.3: na me bhante sāriputta khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
mn143:4.4: seyyathāpi bhante sāriputta balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭṭhanaṃ dadeyya evameva kho me bhante sāriputta adhimattā vātā sīsaṃ parikantanti
mn143:4.5: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
mn143:4.6: seyyathāpi bhante sāriputta dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya evameva kho me bhante sāriputta adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti
mn143:4.7: na me bhante sārīputta khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
mn143:4.8: seyyathāpi bhante sāriputta dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ evameva kho me bhante sāriputta adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho
mn143:4.9: na me bhante sāriputta khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
mn143:5.2: na cakkhuṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me cakkhunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:5.5: na sotaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me sotanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:5.8: na ghānaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me ghānanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:5.11: na jivhaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me jivhānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:5.14: na kāyaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me kāyanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:5.17: na manaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manonissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:6.2: na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:6.9: na dhammaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me dhammanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:7.2: na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me cakkhuviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:7.9: na manoviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manoviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:8.2: na cakkhusamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me cakkhusamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:8.9: na manosamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manosamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:9.2: na cakkhusamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me cakkhusamphassajavedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:9.9: na manosamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manosamphassajavedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:10.2: na paṭhavīdhātuṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me paṭhavīdhātunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:10.9: na viññāṇadhātuṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:11.2: na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:11.8: na viññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me viññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:12.2: na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me ākāsānañcāyatananissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:12.7: na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me nevasaññānāsaññāyatananissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:13.2: na idhalokaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me idhalokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:14.2: na paralokaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me paralokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:14.5: yampi me diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi na upādiyissāmi na ca me tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn143:15.1: evaṃ vutte anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati parodi assūni pavattesi.
mn143:15.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
mn143:15.3: oleyyāsi kho tvaṃ gahapati saṃsīdi kho tvaṃ gahapatīti.
mn143:15.4: nāhaṃ bhante ānanda oleyyāmi na saṃsīdāmi
mn143:15.5: apica me dīgharattaṃ satthā payirupāsito manobhāvanīyā ca bhikkhū
mn143:15.7: na kho gahapati gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammikathā paṭibhāti
mn143:15.9: tenahi bhante sāriputta gihīnaṃpi odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammikathā paṭibhātu
mn143:15.10: santi hi bhante kulaputtā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti
mn143:16.1: atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca ānando anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
mn143:16.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati acirapakkante āyasmante ca sāriputte āyasmante ca ānande kālamakāsi tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjīti.
mn143:17.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn143:17.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
mn143:18.4: samanuñño me satthāti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
mn143:19.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
mn143:19.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn143:19.3: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so devaputto maṃ imāhi gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi
mn143:19.21: samanuñño me satthāti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
mn143:20.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn143:20.2: so hi nūna so bhante anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati
mn143:20.3: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati āyasmante sāriputte abhippasanno ahosīti.
mn143:20.5: yāvatakaṃ kho ānanda takkāya pattabbaṃ anuppattaṃ tayā
mn143:20.8: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
